an1.21:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so unworkable as this mind that is not developed.
an1.22:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so workable as this mind that is developed
an1.23:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not developed.
an1.23:1.2: An undeveloped mind is very harmful.”
an1.24:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is developed.
an1.24:1.2: A developed mind is very beneficial.”
an1.25:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not developed or manifested.
an1.25:1.2: An undeveloped and unmanifested mind is very harmful.”
an1.26:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is developed and manifested.
an1.26:1.2: A developed and manifested mind is very beneficial.”
an1.27:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very harmful as this mind that is not developed and cultivated.
an1.27:1.2: An undeveloped and uncultivated mind is very harmful.”
an1.28:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that is so very beneficial as this mind that is developed and cultivated.
an1.28:1.2: A developed and cultivated mind is very beneficial.”
an1.29:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that brings such suffering as this mind that is not developed and cultivated.
an1.29:1.2: An undeveloped and uncultivated mind brings suffering.”
an1.30:1.1: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that brings such happiness as this mind that is developed and cultivated.
an1.30:1.2: A developed and cultivated mind brings happiness.”
